# Camera-Captured vs. Digital Input (template fill; generated by template_tables.py)

Test set: Non Nobis Domine pp.1-3 + Gaano Ko Ikaw Kamahal pp.1-9 (both FROZEN in the Stage 1 mask split, author-verified GT, digital PDF + phone photo of each page). Non Nobis p4 (solo staff) is out of scope and not scored.

Δ = Camera − Digital, percentage points. SER lower is better; staff detection and pitch accuracy higher is better. Pitch accuracy ignores note duration. SER and pitch accuracy are end-to-end: staves lost at Stage 2 count as fully wrong.
